sentences.en: So many tasty foods can be prepared with eggplants!
sentences.zh: 用茄子可以做出这么多美味的食物！

sentences.en: They say that an eggplant has lots of nicotine.
sentences.zh: 据说茄子含有大量的尼古丁。

sentences.en: I grow spinach, broccoli, and eggplant in my raised garden bed.
sentences.zh: 我在高架菜园床里种了菠菜、西兰花和茄子。
